summary: Backend-only testing of Language Detection and Fraud Detection/Campaign Settings APIs. All 29 tests passed (100% success rate). New features verified: (1) Language auto-detection from phone country code (+255=Swahili/Tanzania, +33=French/France, etc.), (2) Campaign settings per country with configurable fraud rules (rate limits, min amounts, violation thresholds), (3) Violation types and severity levels, (4) Flagged users endpoint for manual review.

supported_languages_api: /api/languages/supported - Returns en, sw, fr with name, native_name, flag
user_language_preference_api: GET /api/user/language - Returns user's current language preference
admin_campaign_settings_api: POST /api/admin/login - Admin login works with correct credentials
GET /api/admin/campaigns/settings - Returns all country settings (5 countries)
GET /api/admin/campaigns/settings/TZ - Tanzania settings with TZS currency
integration_tests: Full language detection flow for multiple countries
Admin full workflow: login -> settings -> update

critical_code_review_comments: Language detection service well-implemented with comprehensive country code mapping for East Africa, French-speaking Africa, English-speaking Africa, Europe, Americas, Asia
Fraud detection service has proper configurable per-country campaign settings (rate limits, min amounts, violations thresholds)
Violation types enum covers key fraud patterns: velocity_hourly, velocity_daily, micro_transaction, duplicate_receipt, merchant_concentration, same_amount_pattern, rapid_succession
Severity levels properly mapped: LOW=warning, MEDIUM=flag, HIGH=auto-suspend, CRITICAL=immediate action
User fraud statuses: clean, flagged, suspended, banned with proper state transitions
Admin campaign settings endpoint properly protected with admin auth
Violation-types endpoint is public (no auth required) - this may be intentional for frontend reference
context_for_next_testing_agent: All language detection and fraud/campaign settings APIs tested and working. Language detection maps phone country codes to languages: Tanzania/Kenya=Swahili, France/Senegal=French, Nigeria/UK/US=English. Campaign settings configurable per country (TZ, KE, NG, UG, RW, DEFAULT) with fraud rules. Violation-types endpoint is public. Receipt validation still MOCKED (no real TRA/EFD API).

mocked_apis.receipt_validation: Receipt validation is MOCKED - MockRevenueAuthorityAPI in server.py
mocked_apis.fraud_detection_actions: Auto-suspend/flag/ban actions are implemented but no real fraud violations to trigger (would need to test with actual rapid submissions)
